seo.title: Ship Design, Marine R&D & Software | LASAN MARINE
seo.description: Ship design is at the centre of our work. We also take on research-led technical problems and build software for real operational needs.

items.headline: Ship design starts with what the vessel is built to do.
items.lead: We turn operating requirements into a workable design, from principal dimensions and hull form to calculations, drawings and technical documentation for newbuilds and conversions.

items.headline: For the technical questions that still need answers.
items.lead: We use simulation, measurement, testing and data analysis to investigate hydrodynamics, structures, vibration and propulsion when a question needs evidence rather than assumption.

items.headline: Software should remove work, not add more of it.
items.lead: We build management systems, websites, automation and AI-enabled tools around real workflows, real data and the people who use them.

fields.heading: What we do
fields.caption: Ship design is our core discipline. R&D extends our ability to investigate technical questions, while software turns recurring workflow and data problems into usable systems.

items.name: Ship Design
items.desc: From operating requirements or existing vessel data, we develop the design, carry out the calculations and prepare the drawings and technical documentation required for the next stage of the project.

children.name: Hydrostatics, stability, resistance, structures and propulsion

items.name: Research & Development
items.desc: We investigate hydrodynamics, structures, vibration, propulsion and measurement problems using simulation, testing, measurement and data analysis where the question demands more than a standard calculation.

children.name: Measurement and comparison with real-world data

items.name: Software
items.desc: We build custom management systems, websites, automation and AI-enabled applications around the way each organisation actually works.

fields.caption: Ship Design
fields.heading: Every project starts from a different point
fields.body: Some clients come with an operating brief and little else. Others already have drawings and need a defined set of calculations or design updates. We review what already exists, agree the work that still needs to be done, and make the deliverables clear before the project starts.

items.text: Fishing vessels, fisheries support vessels, passenger craft and inland-waterway vessels
Conversions involving function, dimensions, structures or propulsion
Stability, resistance, structural, propeller and shafting calculations
Drawings and technical documentation for construction, retrofit or project handover

fields.heading: Planning a new project?
fields.description: Send us the operating requirements, drawings, data or simply a short description of what you need. We will review the information and come back with a clear view of where we can contribute and what we would need from you next.
